turns.replyText:
Is there anything I should pair it with to get the best result?
To get the best performance and longevity from your French flax linen bedding, pairing it with proper care products and complementary pieces makes a huge difference:
• Gentle Liquid Care: Wash your linen using a mild liquid detergent—such as Bed Threads Gentle Wash Laundry Concentrate—on a cold, gentle cycle, and line dry whenever possible. Avoiding harsh powders, bleach, or brighteners protects the natural flax fibers so they continue to soften over time without weakening.
• Complementary Pillowcases & Layers: Adding extra 100% French Flax Linen Pillowcases or European Pillowcases gives you full, supportive layering that matches the breathability and weight of your sheet set.
